items.title: G-quadruplex profiling using single-cell CUT&Tag offers insight into the epigenetic landscape of the developing mouse brain.
items.title_zh: 使用单细胞CUT&Tag进行G-四链体分析，为发育中小鼠大脑的表观遗传景观提供见解。
items.summary_zh: G-四链体（G4）是非经典DNA结构，因其在基因调控中的潜在作用以及在神经退行性疾病和癌症中的作用而日益受到关注。尽管具有生物学意义，G4结构尚未在组织和细胞类型间被系统研究。在本研究中，我们采用G4单细胞CUT&Tag（G4 scCUT&Tag）来表征出生后小鼠脑细胞中的G4景观，利用scRNA-Seq和scATAC-Seq数据集中常用的单细胞分析方法。使用常规单细胞组学工作流处理并探索我们的数据，我们基于G4异质性区分出不同的细胞谱系，并确定一部分谱系特异性基因显示独特的启动子G4。与scRNA-Seq基因表达谱的多组学整合，使用基于协方差的技术（典型相关分析）和基于迁移学习的方法，能够更准确地注释细胞类型。这些整合不仅揭示G4信号与基因表达之间的相关性，还证明G4 scCUT&Tag能够详细检查复杂组织中的G4异质性，并支持G4谱与其他组学层面的整合分析，为发育中大脑的表观基因组景观

extra.description: G-quadruplexes (G4s) are non-canonical DNA structures that have gained increasing attention for their potential roles in gene regulation and role in neurodegenerative diseases and cancer. Despite their biological significance, G4 structures have not been studied systematically across tissues and cell types. In this study, we employ G4 single-cell CUT&Tag (G4 scCUT&Tag) to characterize G4 landscapes in postnatal mouse brain cells, leveraging single-cell analytical approaches commonly used in scRNA-Seq and scATAC-Seq datasets. Using conventional single-cell omics workflows to process and explore our data, we distinguish distinct cell lineages based on G4 heterogeneity and establish that a subset of lineage-specific genes show unique promoter G4s. Multi-omics integration with scRNA-Seq gene expression profiles, using both a covariance-based technique (canonical correlation analysis) and a transfer learning-based approach, enables more accurate cell-type annotation. These integrations not only reveal correlations between G4 signal and gene expression, but demonstrate that G4 scCUT&Tag enables detailed examination of G4 heterogeneity in complex tissues and supports integrative analysis of G4 profiles with other omics layers, offering new insights into the epigenomic landscapes of the developing brain. Our findings establish G4 scCUT&Tag as a framework for investigating the cellular heterogeneity of G4 landscapes in complex tissues and provide a basis for exploring their relationships with gene regulation and other layers of chromatin organization.

items.title: Biosemantic graph transfer learning for cross-patient cell type annotation and cell–cell interaction analysis in tumor single-cell RNA sequencing
items.title_zh: 用于肿瘤单细胞RNA测序中跨患者细胞类型注释和细胞—细胞相互作用分析的生物语义图迁移学习
items.summary_zh: 摘要 通过单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）探索肿瘤微环境（TME）内的细胞异质性，对于理解癌症进展和治疗反应至关重要。然而，当前scRNA-seq方法缺乏空间背景，并依赖不完整的配体—受体相互作用数据集，限制了准确的细胞类型注释和细胞—细胞通讯推断。本研究使用一种新型图神经网络模型应对这些挑战，增强细胞类型预测和细胞相互作用分析。我们的研究使用了来自19名患者、三种癌症类型（白血病、乳腺浸润性癌和结直肠癌）的49 024个细胞组成的数据集。所提出的scGSL模型表现出稳健性能，在所有数据集上平均准确率为84.83%，精确率为86.23%，召回率为81.51%，F1分数为80.92%。这些指标相较现有方法有显著提升，后者通常表现出较低的性能指标。此外，通过回顾现有关于TME内基因相互作用的文献，scGSL模型被证明能以无监督方式稳健识别具有生物学意义的基因相互作用，并通过多种癌症中关键

extra.description: Abstract The exploration of cellular heterogeneity within the tumor microenvironment (TME) via single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) is essential for understanding cancer progression and response to therapy. Current scRNA-seq approaches, however, lack spatial context and rely on incomplete datasets of ligand–receptor interactions, limiting accurate cell type annotation and cell–cell communication inference. This study addresses these challenges using a novel graph neural network model that enhances cell-type prediction and cell-interaction analysis. Our study utilized a dataset consisting of 49 024 cells from 19 patients across three cancer types: leukemia, breast invasive carcinoma, and colorectal cancer. The proposed scGSL model demonstrated robust performance, achieving an average accuracy of 84.83%, precision of 86.23%, recall of 81.51%, and an F1 score of 80.92% across all datasets. These metrics represent a significant enhancement over existing methods, which typically exhibit lower performance metrics. Additionally, by reviewing existing literature on gene interactions within the TME, the scGSL model proves to robustly identify biologically meaningful gene interactions in an unsupervised manner, validated by significant expression differences in key gene pairs across various cancers. The source code and data used in this study can be found at https://github.com/LiYuechao1998/scGSL.

items.title: CellStressDB: an AI-powered database of cellular responses to physical stressors
items.title_zh: CellStressDB：一个AI驱动的细胞对物理应激源反应数据库
items.summary_zh: 摘要 物理应激源通过触发协调的应激反应程序深刻影响细胞行为，这些程序调节信号传导、基因表达、代谢和细胞命运。在此，我们展示CellStressDB（https://cellstressdb.omic.tech），一个AI驱动的数据库，用于探索细胞对物理应激源的反应。当前版本包含来自131项转录组研究的数据，涵盖人类和小鼠九个物理应激类别和21个组织类别的2,364,816个细胞和1205个批量样本观察。数据和分析被组织为2848个索引分析条目，跨越71个规范物种-组织-应激背景，并保留详细暴露条件。CellStressDB通过22个组织感知分类器提供本体引导的细胞类型注释，并整合941个Geneformer检查点用于上下文特定的计算机扰动。分析包括应激反应程序、差异基因表达、功能富集、调节子活性、细胞类型组成和细胞间通讯（如适用），以及候选化合物优先级排序、可下载数据集和模型，以及用户提供

extra.description: Abstract Physical stressors profoundly influence cellular behavior by triggering coordinated stress-response programs that regulate signaling, gene expression, metabolism, and cell fate. Here, we present CellStressDB (https://cellstressdb.omic.tech), an AI-powered database for exploring cellular responses to physical stressors. The current release contains data from 131 transcriptomic studies, with 2 364 816 cell and 1205 bulk sample observations from human and mouse across nine physical-stress classes and 21 tissue categories. Data and analyses are organized into 2848 indexed analysis entries across 71 canonical species-tissue-stress contexts with detailed exposure conditions retained. CellStressDB provides ontology-guided cell-type annotation through 22 tissue-aware classifiers and incorporates 941 Geneformer checkpoints for context-specific in silico perturbation. Analyses include stress-response programs, differential gene expression, functional enrichment, regulon activity, cell-type composition, and cell–cell communication where applicable, with candidate compound prioritization, downloadable datasets and models, and analysis of user-provided transcriptomic data. Annotation evaluation and known-factor recovery analyses indicated context-dependent performance and coverage across biological settings. The mouse radiation-intestine example identifies Stat1 as a candidate regulator of radiation-induced intestinal injury supported by independent experimental evidence. Overall, CellStressDB provides an integrated, AI-enabled framework for exploring and interpreting cellular responses to physical stressors and generating testable hypotheses.

items.title: CROST 2.0: an expanded repository of spatial transcriptomics.
items.title_zh: CROST 2.0：扩展的空间转录组学资源库。
items.summary_zh: CROST（https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/crost）是一个公共空间转录组学资源，提供精选数据集、标准化分析结果、结构化空间知识和交互式探索工具。在2.0版本中，我们的收藏扩展到544个项目、3538个样本，比1.0版本（182个项目、1033个样本）增加了近三倍。我们还大幅扩展了空间共定位和空间可变癌症基因的衍生资源。为促进空间微环境分析，CROST 2.0引入了一个分析框架，包括生态位相关差异表达、空间分辨基因集活性分析、空间交互热点和主题分析，以及分子和细胞类型生态位分析。CROST 2.0还提供Spatial Compare功能，用于比较样本间的空间基因表达、细胞类型分布和生态位组成。它引入了Cancer NicheDE模块，系统表征癌症生态位相关差异表达，并整合了在线细胞类型注释工具SCType，使单细胞参考信息可用于空间转录组分析。这些更新将CROST扩展为一

extra.description: CROST (https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/crost) is a public spatial transcriptomics resource that offers curated datasets, standardized analytical results, structured spatial knowledge, and interactive exploration tools. In version 2.0, our collection has expanded to 544 projects and 3538 samples, nearly a three-fold increase from version 1.0 (182 projects and 1033 samples). We have also substantially expanded the derived resources for spatial colocalization and spatially variable cancer genes. To facilitate spatial microenvironment analysis, CROST 2.0 introduces an analytical framework comprising niche-associated differential expression, spatially resolved gene-set activity analysis, spatial interaction hotspot and topic analyses, and molecular and cell-type niche analysis. CROST 2.0 also provides the Spatial Compare function to compare spatial gene expression, cell-type distributions, and niche composition across samples. It introduces the Cancer NicheDE module to systematically characterize cancer niche-associated differential expression and integrates an online cell-type annotation tool, SCType, enabling the use of single-cell reference information in spatial transcriptomic analysis. These updates extend CROST into an integrated spatial transcriptomics resource for characterizing spatial microenvironments, investigating cancer-associated spatial features, and comparing spatial patterns across samples.

items.title: GLAlign integrates single-cell multi-omics data via global manifold and local marker gene alignment
items.title_zh: GLAlign通过全局流形和局部标记基因比对整合单细胞多组学数据
items.summary_zh: 摘要 整合异质单细胞多组学数据集仍然具有挑战性，因为不同模态在 distinct 特征空间中测量，且缺乏细胞水平配对。现有流形比对或特征转换框架常受弱跨模态关联、几何模糊和过度校正影响。在此，我们提出GLAlign（全局流形和局部标记基因比对），这是一个优化框架，联合利用全局流形结构和局部标记基因信息来整合单细胞多组学数据。GLAlign通过由最大均值差异、失真和惩罚项组成的全局目标，以及由独立推断簇之间跨模态标记基因重叠引导的局部对比三元组损失，学习共享潜在空间。我们展示了GLAlign的方法学贡献，即通过生物学信息先验扩展流形比对，以确保几何上合理且生物学上正确的比对，而无需配对细胞或人工细胞类型注释。我们在模拟数据和真实数据集上评估了GLAlign，涵盖PBMC scRNA-seq/scATAC-seq、小鼠脑SNARE-seq、单供者和多批次CITE-seq，以及NCI-N87 s

extra.description: Abstract Integrating heterogeneous single-cell multi-omics datasets remains challenging because different modalities are measured in distinct feature spaces and lack cell level pairing. Existing manifold alignment or feature conversion framework are often affected by weak cross-modality associations, geometric ambiguity, and overcorrection. Here we present GLAlign (Global manifold and Local marker gene Alignment), an optimization framework that jointly leverages global manifold structure and local marker gene information to integrate single-cell multi-omics data. GLAlign learns a shared latent space through a global objective comprising maximum mean discrepancy, distortion, and penalty terms, together with a local contrastive triplet loss guided by cross-modality marker gene overlap between independently inferred clusters. We demonstrate GLAlign’s methodological contribution in extending the manifold alignment by biologically informed prior to ensure geometrically plausible and biologically correct alignments without requiring paired cells or manual cell type annotations. We evaluated GLAlign on simulated data and real datasets spanning PBMC scRNA-seq/scATAC-seq, mouse brain SNARE-seq, single-donor and multi-batch CITE-seq, and NCI-N87 scDNA-seq/scRNA-seq integration. Across the evaluated datasets, GLAlign achieved strong modality mixing and biological conservation, remained stable under moderate cell type imbalance and variations in clustering and marker information, and supported cross-modality label transfer and paired cell recovery. These results demonstrate that biologically structured coupling of global and local alignment provides an interpretable framework for heterogeneous single-cell multi-omics integration. GLAlign is freely available at https://github.com/Bateer-Bio/GLAlign.

items.title: HGMetaADR: a multimodal heterogeneous graph meta-learning framework for generalized adverse drug reaction prediction
items.title_zh: HGMetaADR：用于广义药物不良反应预测的多模态异质图元学习框架
items.summary_zh: 摘要 早期识别药物不良反应（ADR），即正常剂量用药后出现的有害或非预期反应，对于减少临床试验失败和相关经济成本至关重要。然而，现有ADR数据集常呈现长尾标签分布，且稀有副作用缺乏足够训练样本，使普通监督学习模型难以泛化到代表性不足的类别。为解决这些问题，我们提出HGMetaADR，一种用于ADR预测的新型基于异质图的元学习框架。该方法构建在多模态生物医学知识图上，整合互补的药物相关数据，包括分子结构、蛋白质序列、副作用和治疗适应症。它采用分层注意力机制捕捉异质实体间的语义依赖，并采用模型无关的元学习策略增强对小样本类别的适应能力。我们在少样本、零样本和多数三种情景下评估HGMetaADR，以模拟真实世界条件。大量实验表明，HGMetaADR始终优于最先进基线。此外，消融研究和通路富集分析揭示了连接蛋白质靶点、治疗适应症和副作用的潜在生物学机制，从而验证了将异质生物医学知识纳入ADR建模的

extra.description: Abstract Early identification of adverse drug reactions (ADRs), which refer to harmful or unintended responses to medications taken at normal doses, is crucial for reducing clinical trial failures and associated economic costs. However, existing ADR datasets often exhibit a long-tailed label distribution and lack sufficient training examples for rare side effects, making it difficult for vanilla supervised learning models to generalize to underrepresented classes. To address these issues, we propose HGMetaADR, a novel heterogeneous graph-based meta-learning framework for ADR prediction. Built upon a multimodal biomedical knowledge graph, this approach integrates complementary drug-related data, including molecular structures, protein sequences, side effects, and therapeutic indications. It employs a hierarchical attention mechanism to capture semantic dependencies across heterogeneous entities and adopts a model-agnostic meta-learning strategy to enhance adaptation to small-sample classes. We evaluate HGMetaADR under three scenarios—few-shot, zero-shot, and majority—to simulate real-world conditions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HGMetaADR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Furthermore, ablation studies and pathway enrichment analyses reveal the underlying biological mechanisms linking protein targets, therapeutic indications, and side effects, thereby validating the effectiveness of incorporating heterogeneous biomedical knowledge into ADR modeling.

items.title: Joint single-cell capture of Cas9 edits and transcriptomes reveals on- and off-target effects on gene expression.
items.title_zh: 联合单细胞捕获Cas9编辑和转录组，揭示对基因表达的靶向和非靶向效应。
items.summary_zh: 用CRISPR-Cas9进行基因组工程的一个长期障碍是无法在单细胞分辨率下测量编辑结果及其功能效应。在此我们提出Superb-seq，通过整合Cas9编辑、T7原位转录和单细胞RNA测序来捕获单细胞编辑和转录组效应。我们对来自三种细胞系的35,000个细胞进行了Superb-seq。使用七条guide RNA靶向10,000个K562细胞中的四个染色质重塑基因，Superb-seq检测到5,761个编辑细胞、所有靶向位点和36个非靶向位点。与Perturb-seq相比，Superb-seq改善了对下游扰动对基因表达效应的估计。我们将Superb-seq与4种bulk非靶向检测方法进行比较，在3条基准guide中鉴定出6到210个编辑位点。19个非靶向编辑与差异基因表达相关，其中9个具有细胞类型特异性。总之，Superb-seq通过将单细胞编辑与基因表达变化联系起来，阐明了Cas9基因组编辑

extra.description: A longstanding barrier in genome engineering with CRISPR-Cas9 has been the inability to measure editing outcomes and their functional effects at single-cell resolution. Here we present Superb-seq, which captures single-cell edits and transcriptome effects by integrating Cas9 editing, T7 in situ transcription and single-cell RNA sequencing. We performed Superb-seq on 35,000 cells from three cell lines. Using seven guide RNAs to target four chromatin remodeler genes in 10,000 K562 cells, Superb-seq detected 5,761 edited cells, all on-target sites and 36 off-target sites. Superb-seq improved estimation of downstream perturbation effects on gene expression compared to Perturb-seq. We compared Superb-seq to 4 bulk off-target detection methods and identified between 6 and 210 edit sites across 3 benchmarking guides. Nineteen off-target edits were associated with differential gene expression, nine of which were cell type-specific. In summary, Superb-seq illuminates the consequences of Cas9 genome editing by connecting single-cell edits with changes in gene expression.

items.title: ASAOT: an accentuated structure-differentiated asymmetric optimal transport model for cell type and single-cell spatial mapping
items.title_zh: ASAOT：一种用于细胞类型和单细胞空间映射的增强结构差异化非对称最优传输模型
items.summary_zh: 摘要 空间转录组学（STs）表征时空基因表达，并促进对组织微环境中细胞结构和细胞间通讯的分析。然而，现有空间解卷积方法采用全局固定平滑而无局部锐化，这会模糊细胞边界并阻碍脑组织中分层、异质性细胞模式的重建。在此，我们提出增强结构差异化非对称最优传输（ASAOT），一个基于结构增强非对称最优传输的解卷积框架。结合空间邻域约束，ASAOT引入差异化增强锐化项以维持全局空间连续性、增强边界检测并保留斑点级表达异质性。利用非对称最优传输，该框架联合估计斑点级细胞类型比例并对参考单细胞坐标进行空间分配。在多种模拟数据集上的基准测试表明，ASAOT在中等空间分辨率下实现了有竞争力的整体准确性和稳健性，在测试方法中平均综合排名最佳。应用于小鼠嗅球和大脑皮层数据集表明，ASAOT减少了信号扩散和边界失真，有效恢复分层脑解剖结构和分层细胞分布，从而构建参考单细胞图谱的可解释空间图。总体而言，ASAOT通过锐

extra.description: Abstract Spatial transcriptomics (STs) characterizes spatiotemporal gene expression and facilitates analysis of cellular architecture and cell–cell crosstalk within tissue microenvironments. However, existing spatial deconvolution methods employ globally fixed smoothing without local sharpening, which blurs cellular boundaries and impedes reconstruction of layered, heterogeneous cellular patterns in brain tissue. Here, we present Accentuated Structure-differentiated Asymmetric Optimal Transport (ASAOT), a deconvolution framework built on structure-enhanced asymmetric optimal transport. Coupled with spatial neighborhood constraints, ASAOT introduces a differentiated accentuated sharpening term to maintain global spatial continuity, enhance boundary detection, and preserve spot-level expression heterogeneity. Using asymmetric optimal transport, the framework jointly estimates spot-wise cell-type proportions and performs spatial assignment of reference single-cell coordinates. Benchmarks on diverse simulated datasets demonstrate that ASAOT achieves competitive overall accuracy and robustness across moderate spatial resolutions, with the best average comprehensive rank among tested methods. Applications to mouse olfactory bulb and cerebral cortex datasets demonstrate that ASAOT reduces signal diffusion and boundary distortion, effectively recovering layered brain anatomy and stratified cell distributions to build interpretable spatial maps of reference single-cell profiles. Collectively, ASAOT addresses critical drawbacks of conventional methods via a sharpening regularization term, serving as a reliable tool for STs analysis and mechanism exploration of tissue spatial organization.

items.title: spOT-NMF: gene expression deconvolution via optimal transport with proximity-aware niche mapping for spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: spOT-NMF：通过最优传输与邻近感知生态位映射进行基因表达反卷积用于空间转录组学
items.summary_zh: 摘要 空间转录组学能够直接分析完整组织内的细胞组织，然而两个挑战限制了其充分利用：混合表达信号（包括异种移植等物种混合模型）的准确无参考反卷积，以及缺乏能将每个斑点的程序使用值转化为空间生态位的工具。我们开发了spOT-NMF，一种基于最优传输的非负矩阵分解方法，用Wasserstein距离替代标准重建损失，无需匹配的单细胞图谱即可解开混合信号。虽然广义OT-NMF分解适用于任何表达矩阵，但基于邻近性的生态位推断模块进一步将空间转录组中的程序共使用转化为定义组织区室及其边界的方向共现网络。在涵盖亚细胞到多细胞分辨率、多个平台和两种物种混合场景的五个金标准数据集上进行基准测试，spOT-NMF在无参考方法中排名第一，在异种移植特有的信号不平衡条件下尤其具有优势。我们表明无参考反卷积能够恢复匹配单细胞图谱中缺失的细胞群体，突显了无监督分析的价值。应用于胶质母细胞瘤异种移植和人类结直肠癌，spO

extra.description: Abstract Spatial transcriptomics enables direct profiling of cellular organization within intact tissues, yet two challenges limit its full exploitation: accurate reference-free deconvolution of mixed expression signals (including species-admixed models such as xenografts), and lack of tools that can translate per-spot program usage values into spatial niches. We developed spOT-NMF, an optimal transport-based non-negative matrix factorization method that replaces standard reconstruction loss with the Wasserstein distance to disentangle mixed signals without requiring matched single-cell atlases. While the generalized OT-NMF factorization is applicable to any expression matrix, a proximity-based niche inference module further translates program co-usage from spatial transcriptomes into directional co-occurrence networks that define tissue compartments and their boundaries. Benchmarking across five gold-standard datasets spanning sub-cellular to multi-cellular resolutions, multiple platforms, and two-species admixture scenarios, spOT-NMF ranks first among reference-free methods, with particular advantage under the signal imbalance conditions characteristic of xenografts. We show that reference-free deconvolution recovers cell populations absent from matched single-cell atlases, highlighting the value of unsupervised analysis. Applied to glioblastoma xenografts and human colorectal cancer, spOT-NMF reveals spatially restricted interferon signaling, invasion routes, and CAF–tumor boundaries. spOT-NMF is available as an open-source Python package with GPU, CPU, and HPC support.

items.title: Identifying multi-omics spatial domains via masked autoencoder and diffusion-based latent regularization with SpaMEDM
items.title_zh: 通过掩码自编码器和基于扩散的潜在正则化与SpaMEDM识别多组学空间域
items.summary_zh: 摘要 空间多组学数据提供了组织组织的互补分子视图。然而，由于数据稀疏性、技术噪声和模态特异性分布，其整合仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了空间掩码自编码器和基于扩散的模型（SpaMEDM），一个端到端图表示学习框架，它增强了双注意力图整合骨干，并加入了掩码重建和基于扩散的潜在噪声预测正则化。在掩码轨道中，通过利用模态和图特定的邻域信息来恢复随机掩码的斑点特征。同时，在随机采样的噪声水平下对模态特定的潜在表示施加高斯扰动，并训练一个空间图信息网络来预测注入的噪声。这种基于扩散的目标仅在训练期间使用，以鼓励对潜在扰动的鲁棒性，而不是在推理期间执行迭代反向扩散或采样。此外，基于余弦的配对斑点方向对齐和邻接重建鼓励兼容的跨模态表示并保留所选图结构。SpaMEDM灵活支持纯空间、双特征-空间和模态特定特征修剪的空间图配置。在不同空间多组学数据集上的评估展示了有竞争力的空间域识别性能，并产生促进下游探

extra.description: Abstract Spatial multi-omics data provide complementary molecular views of tissue organization. However, their integration remains challenging due to data sparsity, technical noise, and modality-specific distributions. Here, we present Spatial Masked autoEncoder and Diffusion-based Model (SpaMEDM), an end-to-end graph representation learning framework that augments a dual-attention graph-integration backbone with masked reconstruction and diffusion-based latent noise-prediction regularization. In the masked track, randomly masked spot features are recovered by leveraging modality- and graph-specific neighborhood information. In parallel, Gaussian perturbations are applied to modality-specific latent representations at randomly sampled noise levels, and a spatial-graph-informed network is trained to predict the injected noise. This diffusion-based objective is used exclusively during training to encourage robustness to latent perturbations, rather than to perform iterative reverse diffusion or sampling during inference. Furthermore, cosine-based paired-spot directional alignment and adjacency reconstruction encourage compatible cross-modality representations and preservation of the selected graph structure. SpaMEDM flexibly supports purely spatial, dual feature–spatial, and modality-specific feature-pruned spatial graph configurations. Evaluations across diverse spatial multi-omics datasets demonstrate competitive spatial-domain identification performance and produce integrated embeddings that facilitate downstream exploratory analyses.

items.title: Structured multi-view relational learning for drug response prediction
items.title_zh: 用于药物反应预测的结构化多视图关系学习
items.summary_zh: 摘要 药物反应预测（DRP）需要能够联合表征分子药物结构和异质细胞状态的模型。尽管近期深度学习方法已将多组学图谱与药物表征整合，但许多方法将组学视图视为并行特征来源或在关系建模前将其合并，这可能削弱组学视图特异的细胞系关系结构。在此，我们提出MulDR，一个结构化多视图关系学习框架，在药物条件化的细胞–药物交互之前保留组学视图特异的细胞系关系结构。MulDR为通路活性、基因表达、突变和DNA甲基化构建独立的关系结构，学习视图特异的关系细胞表征，并使用互补的基序级、几何感知分子图和Morgan指纹药物表征来条件化其融合。通过这种设计，细胞系相似性在交互阶段之前保持视图依赖，而非被过早压缩为单一特征或关系空间。大量实验表明，MulDR在相同评估协议下持续优于代表性和近期基线，相对于最强基线将均方根误差降低6.07%。对未见药物和细胞系的冷启动评估进一步表明MulDR能泛化到先前未见的实体，而消

extra.description: Abstract Drug response prediction (DRP) requires models that jointly characterize molecular drug structure and heterogeneous cellular states. Although recent deep learning approaches have integrated multi-omics profiles with drug representations, many treat omics views as parallel feature sources or merge them before relational modeling, which can weaken omics-view-specific cell-line relation structures. Here, we propose MulDR, a structured multi-view relational learning framework that preserves omics-view-specific cell-line relation structures before drug-conditioned cell–drug interaction. MulDR constructs separate relation structures for pathway activity, gene expression, mutation, and DNA methylation, learns view-specific relational cell representations, and uses complementary motif-level, geometry-aware molecular graph, and Morgan fingerprint drug representations to condition their fusion. With this design, cell-line similarity remains view-dependent until the interaction stage, rather than being prematurely compressed into a single feature or relation space. Extensive experiments show that MulDR consistently outperforms representative and recent baselines under the same evaluation protocol, reducing root mean square error by 6.07% relative to the strongest baseline. Cold-start evaluations on unseen drugs and cell lines further show that MulDR generalizes to previously unseen entities, while ablation studies show that removing either view-specific relational modeling or drug-conditioned fusion consistently compromises predictive performance. Together, these results suggest that preserving omics-specific cell-line relations before drug-conditioned interaction modeling provides an effective strategy for robust DRP.

items.title: Multi-omics survival prediction under modality incompleteness via dynamic modality graphs and product-of-experts fusion
items.title_zh: 通过动态模态图和专家乘积融合在模态不完整下的多组学生存预测
items.summary_zh: 摘要 多组学数据整合为癌症生存预测提供了丰富的互补信息，然而模态不完整在真实医疗数据中普遍存在，削弱了现有模型的稳定性和适用性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出DMG-PoE，一个用于多组学生存预测的稳健学习框架。该框架引入动态模态图（DMG），在模态节点之间传播互补信息以补偿缺失输入，并结合不确定性感知的专家乘积（PoE）融合机制，按每个模态的估计精度自适应加权，以及一致性约束训练策略，在不同模态子集上稳定预测。在SurvBoard基准上对10种TCGA癌症类型和七种组学模态的系统评估表明，DMG-PoE在标准设置（完整模态训练/测试）和缺失增强设置（训练额外包含真实不完整样本和非临床模态丢弃，仅完整测试）下均取得最高平均C-index；受控的逐模态掩蔽实验在22/24个癌症-模态组合中验证了有效的测试时恢复，而仅七种模态中两种可用时的跨队列迁移进一步证实了严重输入限制下的泛化能力。

extra.description: Abstract Multi-omics data integration provides rich complementary information for cancer survival prediction, yet modality incompleteness is pervasive in real-world medical data and undermines the stability and applicability of existing models. To address this challenge, we propose DMG-PoE, a robust learning framework for multi-omics survival prediction. The framework introduces a dynamic modality graph (DMG) that propagates complementary information across modality nodes to compensate for missing inputs, combined with an uncertainty-aware product-of-experts (PoE) fusion mechanism that adaptively weights each modality by its estimated precision, and a consistency-constrained training strategy that stabilizes predictions across varying modality subsets. Systematic evaluation on the SurvBoard benchmark across 10 TCGA cancer types and seven omics modalities demonstrates that DMG-PoE achieves the highest average C-index under both the standard setting (complete-modality training/testing) and the missing-augmented setting (training additionally includes real incomplete samples and nonclinical modality dropout, with complete-only testing); controlled per-modality masking experiments validate effective test-time recovery in 22/24 cancer-modality combinations, and cross-cohort transfer with only two of seven modalities available further confirms generalization under severe input restriction.

items.title: Impact of training data on deep learning–based RNA 3D structure quality assessment
items.title_zh: 训练数据对基于深度学习的RNA 3D结构质量评估的影响
items.summary_zh: 摘要 对预测RNA 3D结构进行准确的免参考评估对于大规模RNA建模至关重要，但训练数据对基于深度学习的质量预测器的影响仍知之甚少。在此，我们对三个用于RNA 3D结构质量评估的深度学习预测器进行了系统的交叉训练分析，每个预测器最初都在不同的训练集上开发。通过在替代（非原生）数据集上重新训练每个预测器——包括专门为本项目创建的新数据集RNA3DQA——并在独立的RNA-Puzzles基准上评估性能，我们系统地评估了模型架构和训练数据组成的相对贡献。我们的结果揭示了跨数据集泛化方面的显著差异，预测器在非原生数据集上训练时往往比在其原生数据集上表现更好。值得注意的是，训练数据集的影响因预测器而异，RNA3DQA特别为ARES模型带来了整体最佳的准确性和排名稳定性结果。原生训练集为RNA3DCNN和lociPARSE带来了更好的性能。这些发现表明，训练数据的特征在塑造免参考RNA 3D结构质量评

extra.description: Abstract Accurate reference-free assessment of predicted RNA 3D structures is essential for large-scale RNA modeling, yet the impact of training data on deep learning–based quality predictors remains poorly understood. Here, we present a systematic cross-training analysis of three deep learning predictors for RNA 3D structure quality assessment, each originally developed on distinct training sets. By retraining each predictor on alternative (nonnative) datasets—including RNA3DQA, a new set created specifically for this project—and evaluating performance on independent RNA-Puzzles benchmarks, we systematically assess the relative contributions of model architecture and training data composition. Our results reveal pronounced differences in cross-dataset generalization, with predictors often performing better when trained on nonnative datasets than on their native ones. Notably, the impact of the training datasets varied across predictors, with RNA3DQA yielding the overall best accuracy and ranking stability results specifically for the ARES model. Native training sets yielded better performance for RNA3DCNN and lociPARSE. These findings demonstrate that the characteristics of the training data play a dominant, model-dependent role in shaping the performance and robustness of reference-free RNA 3D structure quality assessment methods. We conclude with practical recommendations for designing transferable training datasets and for benchmarking deep learning–based quality predictors in RNA structural bioinformatics.

items.title: tRNA database 2026, extended compilation of tRNA sequences and tRNA genes
items.title_zh: tRNA数据库2026，扩展的tRNA序列和tRNA基因汇编
items.summary_zh: 摘要 tRNAdb数据库发布于15年多前，最初是Mathias Sprinzl可追溯到1970年代末的tRNA数据开创性收集的扩展。在其生命周期中，tRNAdb被广泛使用，累计被引用超过1000次。在此我们提出tRNAdb 2026，https://tdb.bioinf.uni-leipzig.de/，一个托管在莱比锡大学的更新版本。tRNAdb 2026的数据覆盖范围增加了约10倍，包含超过500,000条新的线粒体和核tRNA序列以及未改动的遗留数据集。重要的是，遗留数据集的标识符和元数据与原始数据库保持一致，确保先前发表的引用仍然有效且可查找。扩展数据集整合了公开可用的tRNA注释和使用当代预测流程生成的序列，随后进行半自动策展以确保注释质量和一致性。此外，与gtRNAdb等外部资源的交叉引用促进了与现有tRNA注释框架的互操作性。现代化的Web前端提供对tRNAdb 2026的直观

extra.description: Abstract The tRNAdb database, published >15 years ago, originated as an extension of Mathias Sprinzl’s seminal collection of transfer RNA (tRNA) data dating back to the late 1970s. Throughout its lifespan, the tRNAdb has been used extensively, accumulating >1000 citations. Here, we present tRNAdb 2026, https://tdb.bioinf.uni-leipzig.de/, an updated version hosted at Leipzig University. The tRNAdb 2026 features an ~10-fold increase in data coverage, containing >500 000 new mitochondrial and nuclear tRNA sequences together with the unaltered legacy dataset. Importantly, identifiers and metadata of the legacy dataset remain consistent with the original database, ensuring that previously published references remain valid and findable. The expanded dataset integrates publicly available tRNA annotations and sequences generated using contemporary prediction pipelines followed by semiautomated curation to ensure annotation quality and consistency. In addition, cross-references to external resources such as gtRNAdb facilitate interoperability with existing tRNA annotation frameworks. A modern web-based frontend provides intuitive and efficient access to tRNAdb 2026, while an Application Programming Interface enables automated data retrieval and integration into bioinformatics workflows. To support transparent scientific documentation and reproducibility across future updates, we added a versioning system for both current and future database releases.

items.title: X-BCRdb: a cross-disease BCR-paired single-cell database for B-lineage-cell clonotype-transcriptome analysis
items.title_zh: X-BCRdb：用于B系细胞克隆型-转录组分析的跨疾病BCR配对单细胞数据库
items.summary_zh: 摘要 B细胞及其克隆重排的B细胞受体（BCR）构成体液免疫的细胞和分子基础。单细胞RNA测序结合V(D)J分析现在能够将BCR克隆型直接与B细胞转录状态联系起来；然而，现有的免疫受体资源通常以T细胞/TCR为导向，或在BCR特异性分析深度上有限。在此我们提出X-BCRdb，一个用于BCR库、B细胞转录状态和克隆演化整合分析的跨疾病单细胞数据库。当前版本整合了45个疾病或生理类别和13个组织组中的61项研究、1401个样本和903名受试者。它包含2,402,995个处理后的B系细胞，其中1,565,870个细胞具有匹配的转录组和BCR信息，以及3,993,244条注释的BCR记录。统一的分析工作流支持标准化的B细胞注释和BCR库表征，包括克隆型分配、SHM分析、同种型分析、VH/VL配对、谱系重建和公共克隆型分析。Web界面将这些受体特征与跨个体样本、研究和疾病的B细胞转录状态联系起来，并提

extra.description: Abstract B cells and their clonally rearranged B-cell receptors (BCRs) form the cellular and molecular basis of humoral immunity. Single-cell RNA sequencing coupled with V(D)J profiling now enables BCR clonotypes to be linked directly to B-cell transcriptional states; however, existing immune-receptor resources are often T-cell/TCR-oriented or limited in BCR-specific analytical depth. Here, we present X-BCRdb, a cross-disease single-cell database for integrated analysis of BCR repertoires, B-cell transcriptional states, and clonal evolution. The current release harmonizes 61 studies, 1401 samples, and 903 subjects across 45 disease or physiological categories and 13 tissue groups. It contains 2 402 995 processed B-lineage cells, including 1 565 870 cells with matched transcriptome and BCR information, and 3 993 244 annotated BCR records. A unified analytical workflow supports standardized B-cell annotation and BCR repertoire characterization, including clonotype assignment, SHM profiling, isotype analysis, VH/VL pairing, lineage reconstruction, and public clonotype analysis. The web interface links these receptor features with B-cell transcriptional states across individual samples, studies and diseases, and provides global CDR3 similarity search, data download, and API access. X-BCRdb is freely available at https://xbcrdb.net/ and provides a systematic platform for studying disease-associated B-lineage-cell responses and facilitating the prioritization of candidate BCR sequences for downstream antibody discovery and functional validation.

items.title: Database resources of the National Genomics Data Center, China National Center for Bioinformation in 2027
items.title_zh: 国家基因组科学数据中心、中国国家生物信息中心2027年数据库资源
items.summary_zh: 摘要 国家基因组科学数据中心（NGDC）作为中国国家生物信息中心（CNCB）的一部分，为全球学术和工业界提供一系列数据库资源和Web服务。鉴于多组学数据的快速增长以及人工智能对高质量策展数据的内在依赖，CNCB–NGDC持续增强数据完整性、可用性和可访问性，促进知识发现，支持数据驱动研究。过去一年，CNCB–NGDC扩展和更新了其核心数据库资源，并加强了与国际合作者的数据交换和共享。发布了13个新资源，涵盖基因组与变异（HLA和NMVR）、健康与疾病（PWAS Atlas、CoVAR-KG、HONOR、IBDkb和MTB-ImmunogenKG）、生物多样性与生物合成（iCellOmics、iPangolin、SesbaniaOmics和Vita Taxonomy）以及工具（π-OmicsKit和DeepSeMS）。所有资源和服务均可在https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn公开访问

extra.description: Abstract The National Genomics Data Center (NGDC), as part of the China National Center for Bioinformation (CNCB), provides a family of database resources and web services to both academic and industrial communities worldwide. Given the rapid growth of multi-omics data and the intrinsic dependence of artificial intelligence on high-quality curated data, CNCB–NGDC continues to enhance data integrity, usability, and accessibility, facilitate knowledge discovery, and support data-driven research. Over the past year, CNCB–NGDC has expanded and updated its core database resources and strengthened data exchange and sharing with international collaborators. Thirteen new resources have been released, covering genome and variation (HLA and NMVR), health and disease (PWAS Atlas, CoVAR-KG, HONOR, IBDkb, and MTB-ImmunogenKG), biodiversity and biosynthesis (iCellOmics, iPangolin, SesbaniaOmics, and Vita Taxonomy), and tools (π-OmicsKit and DeepSeMS). All resources and services are publicly accessible at https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn.

items.title: Echidna: a Bayesian framework for integrative inference of copy number alterations impacting phenotypic plasticity.
items.title_zh: Echidna：用于整合推断影响表型可塑性的拷贝数变异的贝叶斯框架。
items.summary_zh: 细胞根据遗传或环境变化调整行为的能力是驱动正常和病理背景（包括肿瘤演化）中细胞多样性的基本生物过程。拷贝数变异（CNA）可包括基因组倍性的大规模变化，在演化中的细胞群体中创造适应性优势方面发挥关键作用。然而，跨实验追踪这些群体并将CNA的作用与其他转录变异来源区分开来仍然具有挑战性且昂贵。在此我们提出Echidna，一个贝叶斯分层模型，整合单细胞RNA测序和bulk全基因组测序数据，以跨样本和治疗时间点联合稳健地整合推断CNA，从而更好地理解基因组事件对细胞表型的影响。将Echidna应用于患者肿瘤标本，我们展示了其在克隆重建中的优越性能，并获得对治疗耐药机制的见解。

extra.description: The ability of cells to adapt their behavior in response to genetic or environmental changes is a fundamental biological process that drives cellular diversity in both normal and pathological contexts, including in tumor evolution. Copy number alterations (CNAs), which can include large-scale changes in genomic ploidy, play a key role in creating adaptive advantages in evolving cell populations. However, tracing these populations across experiments and disentangling the role of CNAs from other sources of transcriptional variability remains challenging and expensive. Here we present Echidna, a Bayesian hierarchical model that integrates single-cell RNA sequencing and bulk whole-genome sequencing data to enable robust integrative inference of CNAs, jointly across samples and treatment time points, to better understand the impact of genomic events on cellular phenotype. Applying Echidna to patient tumor specimens, we demonstrate its superior performance in clonal reconstruction and derive insights into therapy resistance mechanisms.

items.title: 基于威胁感知的Tor多路径选择
items.title_zh: 基于威胁感知的Tor多路径选择
items.summary_zh: 随着机器学习和深度学习的发展应用,攻击者可以通过Tor用户链路上的恶意节点以及恶意AS对其进行流量分析,从而对Tor用户进行去匿名化攻击。目前,常见的针对流量分析攻击的防御方法有两类:一类是通过插入虚拟数据包,或者延迟真实数据包从而改变流量特征,这种方法会引入带宽和时延开销;另一类将用户流量分割并通过多个路径传输从而进行防御,这种方法缺少对电路上存在的恶意节点以及恶意AS的感知,当攻击者搜集到完整流量踪迹时,依旧难以抵御流量分析对Tor用户的去匿名化攻击。为了弥补多路径防御方法在路径选择上存在的缺乏威胁感知的问题,提出了融合恶意节点感知以及恶意AS感知的基于威胁感知的多路径选择算法。首先提出一种改进的节点距离度量的方法,然后使用改进后的距离度量,基于K-Mediods算法对节点进行聚类,提高了恶意节点的检测效果;之后改进了AS感知算法,提高了匿名性要求;最后融合恶意节点检测以及AS感知算法

extra.description: 随着机器学习和深度学习的发展应用,攻击者可以通过Tor用户链路上的恶意节点以及恶意AS对其进行流量分析,从而对Tor用户进行去匿名化攻击。目前,常见的针对流量分析攻击的防御方法有两类:一类是通过插入虚拟数据包,或者延迟真实数据包从而改变流量特征,这种方法会引入带宽和时延开销;另一类将用户流量分割并通过多个路径传输从而进行防御,这种方法缺少对电路上存在的恶意节点以及恶意AS的感知,当攻击者搜集到完整流量踪迹时,依旧难以抵御流量分析对Tor用户的去匿名化攻击。为了弥补多路径防御方法在路径选择上存在的缺乏威胁感知的问题,提出了融合恶意节点感知以及恶意AS感知的基于威胁感知的多路径选择算法。首先提出一种改进的节点距离度量的方法,然后使用改进后的距离度量,基于K-Mediods算法对节点进行聚类,提高了恶意节点的检测效果;之后改进了AS感知算法,提高了匿名性要求;最后融合恶意节点检测以及AS感知算法提出了一种基于威胁感知的多路径选择算法。实验结果表明,该算法不仅能抵抗多种流量分析攻击,而且保证了一定的Tor电路性能。

items.title: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.title_zh: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.summary_zh: 物联网(IoT)中激增的流量, 影响了传感器等设备的数据传输。利用软件定义网络(SDN)技术可以优化网络性能, 提高数据传输质量。然而, 物联网中流量等网络状态的不断变化会影响软件定义网络控制平面的性能。研究软件定义物联网(SD-IoT)中的动态控制器部署问题, 以在流量变化时保证控制平面性能。考虑到物联网节点的能耗以及数据传输的特点, 在部署控制器时, 综合考虑延迟、控制可靠性以及能耗的影响, 并将该问题构建为马尔可夫博弈过程。为了同时兼顾单一控制器性能以及控制平面整体性能, 采用多智能体深度强化学习求解该问题。在部署阶段利用动作掩码屏蔽部分节点, 避免将控制器部署在性能不足或者供能不方便的节点。仿真实验表明, 与基于Louvain社区划分和基于单智能体深度Q网络(DQN)的部署算法相比, 所提算法可以更好地找到高性能的部署方案。

items.title: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构

items.title: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.title_zh: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.summary_zh: 在高速收费站拥堵检测场景中, 遮挡、阴影、景深等因素严重影响检测算法的精度, 基于单信息的拥堵检测算法无法准确反映收费站真实拥堵情况, 对此, 提出一种高速收费站多信息融合拥堵检测算法。首先采用目标检测算法检测目标区域车辆, 利用图像空间特征计算车道占用率; 其次利用Deep SORT目标跟踪算法与滑动平衡机制进行车流量综合估计, 减少因为遮挡和阴影导致的车辆误检、漏检问题; 最后利用基于光流信息熵的车速估计方法, 降低因景深变化导致的拥堵状态检测误差。通过融合3种不同维度信息得到拥堵指数, 拥堵指数聚类为5种拥堵类别以判断真实拥堵状态, 从而实现高速收费站的拥堵检测。实验结果表明, 在高速收费站拥堵数据集上, 采用多信息融合的拥堵检测算法准确率达到90.4%, 能够实现对收费站拥堵状态的准确检测。

items.title: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.title_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统,也叫智能体操作系统,是整合大模型、工具资源以及多智能体协同的核心平台,目前正逐渐成为推动通用人工智能发展的一个关键研究方向。对智能体操作系统领域的研究进展进行了系统梳理,首先从基础理论着手,回顾了多种大模型的演进情况以及智能体和传统操作系统领域的进展;接着,围绕典型体系结构,如AIOS等,阐述了其分层架构与模块化设计是怎样达成资源管理与智能调度的。进一步地,明确了当前智能体操作系统在上下文整合、扩展性以及安全性等方面面临的技术挑战,同时也提出了未来借助轻量化设计、自监督学习机制以及动态调度算法来提升多智能体协作效率。该研究的主要贡献为,将那些分散的研究给予整合,促使技术框架变得更为明晰,并指出了智能体操作系统对新兴体系以及行业定制化实践覆盖不全面的情况。未来的研究需要侧重推动跨域智能体操作系统自我进化的能力,并且加快其在各个领域的落地等。

items.title: 实际应用场景中的大模型高效推理技术综述
items.title_zh: 实际应用场景中的大模型高效推理技术综述
items.summary_zh: 近年来,大语言模型(Large Language Models,LLMs)技术迎来了快速发展,其在各行业的应用呈现出蓬勃增长的态势。从自然语言处理到智能推荐,再到信息检索和自动化写作,LLMs正逐渐成为许多领域中不可或缺的工具。然而,随着应用场景的逐渐多样化和需求的不断增加,LLMs推理效率问题日益凸显。在实际应用场景中,快速准确的推理能力对于响应用户请求、处理大规模数据和实时决策至关重要。为了应对这一挑战,学术界展开了广泛的研究和探索,致力于提高LLMs的推理效率。对此,全面调研了实际应用场景中有关LLMs高效推理的文献。首先,介绍了LLMs推理的原理,并分析了在实际应用场景中如何提高LLMs的推理效率。然后,引入了一个针对实际应用场景的分类系统,其主要分为3个层面,分别是算法优化层面、参数优化层面和系统优化层面;并对大模型进行相关研究的总结和归纳。最后,探讨了未来可能的研究方向。

items.title: 基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法
items.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法
items.summary_zh: 业务流程应变是业务流程管理的重要任务,旨在通过调整流程模型和实例行为来响应不断变化的环境,从而提高其柔韧性并实现业务目标。建模时,残留不确定性导致的长尾变化无法避免,给传统的业务流程应变技术带来了挑战。目前针对长尾变化最有效的应变方法基于一种三方协作框架,即由负责感知长尾变化和提出应变策略的前端业务人员、负责提供服务接口和合规性要求的后端技术人员和管理层,以及辅助应变实施的工具系统共同协作来应对长尾变化,保障业务目标达成。然而,长尾变化在不同时空条件下的多样性、复杂性和应变的迫切性,极有可能超出前端业务人员在应变时对当前情境的理解能力、依据情境制定应变策略的专业水平,以及将应变策略采用领域专用语言有效表达的熟练程度。为弥补这一缺憾并进一步拓展上述框架,提出了一种基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法LLM-Adapt,充分利用大语言模型的泛化能力、强大的内容生成能力,以及嵌入的事件与对策

items.title: MUSS: A Multi-scale and Sequence-based Model for Single-cell Gene Regulation
items.title_zh: MUSS：一个用于单细胞基因调控的多尺度且基于序列的模型
items.summary_zh: 在单细胞中建模基因调控需要跨调控尺度联合表示DNA序列、染色质可及性和基因表达。基于序列的模型捕获DNA水平的调控语法，但通常缺乏细胞水平的分辨率，而许多单细胞组学模型将基因和峰表示为固定词汇的标记，而没有其底层序列。在这里，我们提出了MUSS，一个基于序列的单细胞基因调控多尺度模型，同时保留DNA水平和细胞水平的分辨率。MUSS使用冻结的预训练序列编码器从DNA推导峰和基因水平的表示，并通过峰-峰自注意力和距离偏置的峰-基因相互作用进行整合。峰掩码语言建模随后在配对的scATAC-seq和scRNA-seq上训练，将这些表示与细胞特异性调控状态对齐。在基因表达预测、增强子-基因连接、基序引导的调控优先级排序和零样本细胞聚类方面，MUSS相对于基于序列和单细胞组学的基线取得了强劲性能。它进一步预测任务训练期间未见过的基因和峰的表达。这些结果支持基于序列的多尺度表示用于解码细胞类型特异性调控

extra.description: Modeling gene regulation in single cells requires jointly representing DNA sequence, chromatin accessibility, and gene expression across regulatory scales. Sequence-based models capture DNA-level regulatory grammar but often lack cell-level resolution, whereas many single-cell omics models represent genes and peaks as fixed-vocabulary tokens without their underlying sequence. Here, we present MUSS, a sequence-based multi-scale model for single-cell gene regulation that preserves both DNA-level and cell-level resolution. MUSS derives peak- and gene-level representations from DNA using a frozen pre-trained sequence encoder and integrates them through peak-peak self-attention and distance-biased peak-gene interactions. Peak masked language modeling followed by training on paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq aligns these representations with cell-specific regulatory states. Across gene expression prediction, enhancer-gene linking, motif-guided regulatory prioritization, and zero-shot cell clustering, MUSS achieves strong performance against sequence-based and single-cell omics baselines. It further predicts expression for genes and peaks unseen during task training. These results support sequence-grounded, multi-scale representations for decoding cell-type-specific regulatory programs. Code, datasets, and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Lotfollahi-lab/MUSS_neurips26.

items.title: Galectin-1 identifies a unique subpopulation of highly invasive glioblastoma cells and enables their migration.
items.title_zh: Galectin-1标识高度侵袭性胶质母细胞瘤细胞的独特亚群并促进其迁移。
items.summary_zh: 胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）是最常见的原发性脑肿瘤，其特征是广泛浸润周围脑组织。GBM肿瘤表现出显著的瘤内异质性，使得难以识别和靶向侵袭性细胞亚群。在此我们使用肿瘤-脑界面的机械转变体外模型，从独特患者肿瘤来源的群体中分离高度侵袭性GBM细胞。使用单细胞RNA测序结合细胞条形码，我们能够追踪迁移过程中的不同细胞谱系，并鉴定出优先跨刚度界面迁移的侵袭性亚群。这种机械敏感的侵袭性亚群表现出以galectin-1（一种β-半乳糖苷结合蛋白）过表达为特征的转录组谱。我们的发现揭示galectin-1表达水平与侵袭率正相关，抑制galectin-1与细胞表面糖蛋白结合可阻止迁移。本研究确定galectin-1表达是机械定义界面模型中侵袭性GBM细胞的特征，其中galectin-1可作为识别和靶向侵袭性GBM细胞的重要标志物。

extra.description: Glioblastoma (GBM), the most common primary brain tumor, is characterized by extensive infiltration into surrounding brain tissue. GBM tumors exhibit substantial intratumoral heterogeneity making it difficult to identify and target invasive cell subpopulations. Here, we use an in vitro model of the mechanical transitions at the tumor-brain interface to isolate highly invasive GBM cells from populations derived from unique patient tumors. Using single-cell RNA sequencing combined with cell barcodes we were able to trace distinct cell lineages during migration and identify an invasive subpopulation which preferentially migrates across stiffness interfaces. This mechanically sensitive invasive subpopulation exhibits a transcriptomic profile characterized by overexpression of galectin-1, a {beta}-galactoside binding protein. Our findings reveal that galectin-1 expression level positively correlates with invasion rate and inhibition of galectin-1 binding to cell surface glycoproteins prevents migration. This study identifies galectin-1 expression is a characteristic of invading GBM cells in mechanically defined interface model where galectin-1 may serve as an important maker to identify and target invasive GBM cells.

items.title: Reproducible quantum clustering for single-cell transcriptome atlases
items.title_zh: 用于单细胞转录组图谱的可复现量子聚类
items.summary_zh: 当前的单细胞聚类流程丢弃了大多数基因，并且在不同随机种子下可能产生不一致的聚类。我们介绍了KQE-2，一个无需训练的混合量子-经典框架，用于可复现的全转录组聚类。KQE-2将细胞映射到无纠缠的量子态，使得能够在经典硬件上进行精确的特征评估，并在量子处理器上直接检查。在理论上，我们证明了消除纠缠是局部限制单量子比特特征方差的必要且充分条件。在实践中，虽然重新训练scVI使14%的细胞发生偏移并改变了稀有类型标记和药物靶点，但KQE-2在多次运行中提供了相同的生物学结果。在标准高变基因上，仅量子编码就将发育中皮层的准确率从0.61提高到0.79。KQE-2可在一台服务器上扩展到1140万个细胞核，在十个完整图谱中的八个上优于所比较的方法（在两个上处于最佳方法的运行间范围内），并且即使在标准下游聚类下也在六个上领先。

extra.description: Current single-cell clustering pipelines discard most genes and can yield inconsistent clusters across random seeds. We introduce KQE-2, a training-free hybrid quantum-classical framework for reproducible whole-transcriptome clustering. KQE-2 maps cells into entanglement-free quantum states, enabling exact feature evaluation on classical hardware and direct checks on a quantum processor. Theoretically, we prove that removing entanglement is necessary and sufficient to bound single-qubit feature variance locally. Practically, while retraining scVI shifted 14% of cells and altered rare-type markers and drug targets, KQE-2 delivered identical biology across runs. On standard highly variable genes, the quantum encoding alone raised accuracy on a developing cortex from 0.61 to 0.79. KQE-2 scales to 11.4 million nuclei on one server, outperforming the compared methods on eight of ten complete atlases (and within the best method's run-to-run range on two), and leads on six even under standard downstream clustering.

items.title: Beyond AUC: Do Mammography Risk Models Predict When Cancer Occurs?
items.title_zh: 超越AUC：乳腺X线摄影风险模型能预测癌症何时发生吗？
items.summary_zh: 用于基于乳腺X线摄影的乳腺癌风险预测的纵向深度学习模型输出每年累积风险或诊断年份的离散分布，由此导出累积风险F1,...,F5。这些模型几乎仅用逐年AUC和一致性指数评估。我们表明这些指标在很大程度上对癌症何时发生不敏感：即使对诊断年份不携带信息的模型，它们也可能很高。我们在CSAW-CC上以5年视野重新评估两个近期纵向模型（OA-BreaCR、LMV-Net），使用仅在癌症病例上计算的时间指标。尽管C指数高达0.75，两者按诊断时间对癌症病例排序均未显著优于随机（c_time 0.51和0.55，95% CI均覆盖0.5）。加权绝对时间误差倾向于常数“第3年”预测而非两个模型，因此我们使用c_time作为主要时间指标。对于Mirai的加性风险头（LMV-Net也使用），我们分析通过ReLU的逐年增量如何在严重类别不平衡下崩溃。我们还提出一个乳腺级两阶段模型，将“是否”与“何时”分开。它在

extra.description: Longitudinal deep learning models for mammography-based breast cancer risk prediction output either per-year cumulative risks or a discrete distribution over the year of diagnosis, from which cumulative risks F1,...,F5 are derived. These models are evaluated almost exclusively with year-wise AUCs and the concordance index. We show that these metrics are largely insensitive to when cancer occurs: they can be high even for a model that carries no information about the year of diagnosis. We re-evaluate two recent longitudinal models (OA-BreaCR, LMV-Net) on CSAW-CC with a 5-year horizon using timing metrics computed on cancer cases only. Despite C-indices up to 0.75, neither orders cancer cases by time to diagnosis significantly better than chance (c_time 0.51 and 0.55, both 95% CIs covering 0.5). Weighted absolute timing error favours a constant "year 3" prediction over both models, so we use c_time as the primary timing metric. For Mirai's additive-hazard head, also used by LMV-Net, we analyse how per-year increments passed through a ReLU can collapse under severe class imbalance. We also propose a breast-level, two-stage model that separates whether from when. It matches LMV-Net in discrimination (C-index 0.745 vs. 0.746) but orders cancer cases better (c_time 0.58 vs. 0.51, paired 95% CI of the difference 0.01-0.13), on par with Mirai's published weights (0.57).

items.title: More Genes, Faster Inference: Efficient Large-Panel Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction from Histology
items.title_zh: 更多基因，更快推理：从组织学高效预测大面板空间转录组
items.summary_zh: 从组织学预测空间转录组（ST）旨在直接从组织图像推断空间分辨的基因表达谱。这是一个具有挑战性的问题，目前通常用复杂的模型架构、额外输入和复杂的训练流程来解决，同时仍局限于固定的小基因面板。这引出一个自然的问题：是否存在一种高效的大面板 ST 预测方法？在此，我们提出 GeneFlow，一个更简单却有效的大规模空间基因表达预测框架，它将流匹配生成建模与结构化多模态融合统一起来。具体而言，GeneFlow 首先通过组织学和基因分词器在空间点上编码组织学形态和跨基因相互作用。该模型直接预测空间基因表达，而非中间速度场，同时以基于速度的流匹配目标进行训练。我们表明，即使不依赖重型生成流程，GeneFlow 在多个 ST 基准上也达到最先进性能，在 1000 基因预测中提升高达 56.8%。大量实验进一步表明，GeneFlow 产生具有生物学意义的点谱，同时将计算成本降低数个数量级，从而提高效率和可

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) prediction from histology aims to infer spatially resolved gene expression profiles directly from tissue images. This is a challenging problem that is currently often addressed with complicated model architectures, additional inputs, and complicated training procedures, while remaining limited to fixed, small gene panels. This raises a natural question: Is there an efficient method for large-panel ST prediction? Here, we present GeneFlow, a simpler yet effective framework for large-scale spatial gene expression prediction that unifies flow-matching generative modeling with structured multimodal fusion. Specifically, GeneFlow first encodes both histological morphology and cross-gene interactions in spatial spots through histology and gene tokenizers. The model directly predicts spatial gene expression, rather than an intermediate velocity field, while being trained with a velocity-based flow-matching objective. We show that, even without relying on heavy generative pipelines, GeneFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple ST benchmarks, with up to 56.8% gains in 1,000-gene prediction. Extensive experiments further show that GeneFlow produces biologically meaningful spot profiles while reducing computational cost by orders of magnitude, thereby improving efficiency and scalability, particularly in clinical settings. We believe GeneFlow provides an opportunity for leveraging widely available histology images for downstream biological discovery. Code is available at: https://github.com/ZZhangsm/GeneFlow

items.title: Bridging Graph and Pairwise Learning for Gene Regulatory Network Inference from scRNA-seq Data
items.title_zh: 融合图学习与成对学习，从scRNA-seq数据推断基因调控网络
items.summary_zh: 动机：基因调控网络（GRNs）捕捉转录因子（TFs）调控基因的潜在相互作用。基于基因表达数据，现有GRN推断方法大致分为两类：基于图的方法，将GRN建模为整体图；基于成对的方法，将GRN分解为单个TF-靶基因对进行建模。然而，每种方法都有局限性，而这些局限恰恰是另一方的优势。基于图的方法因依赖单一训练图而容易过拟合，而成对方法则受益于丰富的TF-靶基因训练对。相反，成对方法忽略了全局拓扑结构，而这对全面捕捉调控机制至关重要。结果：为解决这些局限，我们提出scGPL，一个端到端统一框架，联合建模全局调控拓扑和局部相互作用。scGPL从全局调控图中提取宏观特征，并引入动态的、重要性引导的子图采样机制以捕捉细粒度局部依赖。通过融合全局表示与子图增强的局部特征，我们的框架弥合了两种范式之间的差距，既纳入必要的全图拓扑依赖，又保留成对方法的数据丰富优势。在七个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，scGPL持

extra.description: Motivation: Gene regulatory networks (GRNs) capture the underlying interactions through which transcription factors (TFs) regulate genes. Based on gene expression data, existing GRN inference approaches generally fall into two categories: graph-based methods, which model the GRN as a whole graph, and pairwise-based methods, which decompose the GRN into individual TF-target gene pairs for modeling. However, each approach exhibits limitations that are precisely the strengths of its counterpart. Graph-based methods tend to overfit due to their reliance on a single training graph, whereas pairwise-based methods benefit from abundant TF-target training pairs. In contrast, pairwise-based methods overlook the global topological structure, which is essential for comprehensively capturing regulatory mechanisms. Results: To address these limitations, we propose scGPL, an end-to-end unified framework that jointly models global regulatory topology and local interactions. scGPL extracts macro-level features from the global regulatory graph and introduces a dynamic, importance-guided subgraph sampling mechanism to capture fine-grained local dependencies. By fusing global representations with subgraph-enhanced local features, our framework bridges the gap between the two paradigms, incorporating essential whole-graph topological dependencies while retaining the data abundance advantage of pairwise methods. Extensive experiments on seven benchmark datasets demonstrate that scGPL consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, with up to 13.7% improvement over the strongest baseline, validating the effectiveness of our integrative design. Availability and implementation: The source code is maintained on GitHub (https://github.com/talent-hang/scGPL), and the datasets and versioned releases are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21608485 for reproducibility.

items.title: Publications as benchmarks: auditing AI agents on spatial transcriptomics alignment
items.title_zh: 出版物作为基准：审计AI智能体在空间转录组对齐上的表现
items.summary_zh: AI智能体正越来越多地自动化数据分析，但负责任的采用需要可靠的性能评估，这在专业科学领域成本高昂。我们引入了一个框架，将科学出版物转化为AI智能体可审计的基准，并展示了其在空间转录组对齐任务上的应用。在121个任务、16个基线方法和六个AI智能体中，最佳智能体（GPT-6-Astra和Gemini-4-Argon）在80%的任务上匹配或优于所有基线，通常使用令人惊讶的简单启发式方法。智能体性能对提示和访问预安装包具有鲁棒性。基准构建还揭示了先前工作中的错误和当前评估指标中的捷径。最后，我们表明智能体生成的解决方案可以蒸馏成一个可重用的程序，在未见数据上排名前10%的基线方法。我们的框架提供了一种可扩展的方式，通过利用和压力测试现有论文和指标来评估专业科学领域中的AI智能体。

extra.description: AI agents are increasingly automating data analysis, but responsible adoption requires reliable performance evaluation, which is costly in specialized scientific domains. We introduce a framework that translates scientific publications into auditable benchmarks for AI agents and demonstrate its use on spatial transcriptomics alignment tasks. Across 121 tasks, 16 baseline methods, and six AI agents, the best agents (GPT-6-Astra and Gemini-4-Argon) matched or outperformed all baselines on 80% of tasks, often using surprisingly simple heuristics. Agent performance was robust to prompting and access to pre-installed packages. Benchmark construction also uncovered errors in prior work and shortcuts in current evaluation metrics. Finally, we show that agent-generated solutions can be distilled into a reusable program that ranks in the top 10% of baseline methods on unseen data. Our framework offers a scalable way to evaluate AI agents in specialized scientific domains by leveraging and stress-testing existing papers and metrics.

items.title: Synchronized Optimal Transport Reconstructs Coupled Transcriptomic and Chromatin Dynamics
items.title_zh: 同步最优传输重建耦合的转录组与染色质动态
items.summary_zh: 跨发育阶段收集的单细胞 RNA 和 ATAC 数据提供了转录和调控状态的时间进程快照。由于测序是破坏性的，这些快照之间的轨迹必须从独立采样的细胞群体中推断。现有方法通常在单一模态中推断连续动态，或在共享表示中整合 RNA 和 ATAC。在此我们提出跨组学对齐轨迹推断（COATI），它将非平衡同步动态最优传输扩展为时间依赖的跨模态映射，以在不同 RNA 和 ATAC 状态空间中重建耦合轨迹。我们在合成基准和四个发育数据集上使用留出阶段重建和谱系分析评估了 COATI。COATI 改善了留出阶段细胞群体的重建，包括恢复细胞类型内的染色质状态异质性，并更好地保留了发育谱系关系。非平衡形式允许推断群体质量变化，这些变化被证明与早期阶段的 DNA 复制程序和发育后期的谱系成熟程序相关。耦合轨迹使得分析发育过程中谱系特异的转录和染色质变化及其时间关系成为可能。COATI 推断的谱系响应与独立的 CRI

extra.description: Single-cell RNA and ATAC data collected across developmental stages provide time-course snapshots of transcriptional and regulatory states. Since sequencing is destructive, trajectories between these snapshots must be inferred from independently sampled cell populations. Existing approaches typically infer continuous dynamics in a single modality or integrate RNA and ATAC in a shared representation. Here we present Cross-Omics Aligned Trajectory Inference (COATI), which extends unbalanced synchronized dynamical optimal transport to time-dependent cross-modal maps for reconstructing coupled trajectories in distinct RNA and ATAC state spaces. We evaluated COATI on synthetic benchmarks and four developmental datasets using held-out-stage reconstruction and lineage analyses. COATI improved reconstruction of cell populations at held-out stages, including recovery of chromatin-state heterogeneity within cell types, and better preserved developmental lineage relationships. The unbalanced formulation allows the inference of population mass changes, which were shown to associate with DNA-replication programs at early stages and lineage-maturation programs later in development. The coupled trajectories enabled analysis of lineage-specific transcriptional and chromatin changes and their temporal relationships during development. Lineage responses inferred by COATI agreed with independent CRISPR perturbation results, and the inferred regulatory patterns were consistent with independent epigenetic data.

items.title: HistoTx: Early fusion of H&E images and spatial transcriptomics at varying spatial transcriptomics resolution with self-supervised learning
items.title_zh: HistoTx：在不同空间转录组学分辨率下，通过自监督学习对H&E图像和空间转录组学进行早期融合
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组学绘制组织切片上的基因表达图谱，当与全切片图像整合时，可联合捕获形态结构和分子活动，从而提供组织生物学的丰富多模态视图。将空间转录组学与WSI结合的ML方法通常通过对比对齐或对病理基础模型进行监督微调，学习从形态特征到分子谱的映射。在这两种情况下，转录组学都作为训练信号而非真正的输入模态，使推理从根本上由图像驱动。我们提出一种早期融合视觉Transformer架构，其中转录组token以任意空间分辨率构建，与图像块token合并，并通过共享Transformer堆栈联合处理，以实现深度跨模态交互。从预训练的纯视觉病理基础模型出发，我们通过在配对的图像和空间转录组学数据上继续自监督预训练来训练HistoTx，并证明：1）在仅使用图像进行推理时，性能在大多数任务上与基线持平，同时在本质上受益于分子知识的任务（如基因表达预测）上有所提升；2）当推理时两种模态均可用时，联合提供图像和转录

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics maps gene expression across tissue sections and, when integrated with whole slide images, jointly captures both morphological architecture and molecular activity to provide a rich, multimodal view of tissue biology. ML approaches combining spatial transcriptomics and WSIs typically learn a mapping from morphological features to molecular profiles via contrastive alignment or supervised fine-tuning of pathology foundation models. In both cases, transcriptomics serves as a training signal rather than a true input modality, leaving inference fundamentally image-driven. We propose an early-fusion vision transformer architecture in which transcript tokens are constructed at arbitrary spatial resolution, merged with image patch tokens, and jointly processed through a shared transformer stack for deep cross-modal interaction. Starting from a pretrained vision-only pathology foundation model, we train HistoTx by continuing self-supervised pretraining on paired image and spatial transcriptomics data and demonstrate that: 1) at inference with image only, performance remains on par with the baseline on most tasks while improving on tasks that inherently benefit from molecular knowledge, such as gene expression prediction; 2) when both modalities are available at inference, jointly providing image and transcript inputs outperforms either modality alone.

items.title: Weight-Space Programming Changes How an LLM Uses Python for Computational Biology
items.title_zh: 权重空间编程改变LLM在计算生物学中使用Python的方式
items.summary_zh: 权重空间编程允许语言模型无需基于梯度的训练即可编辑另一模型的权重。我们使用Claude Opus 5.5编辑Qwen3.5-0.8B，并研究编辑如何改变其在计算生物学问题上使用Python的方式。我们在三个测试种子的50个测试问题上比较四个初始编辑检查点与原始模型，产生600次配对评估。严格正确答案从44增加到77，技术正确答案（包括因格式被拒绝的正确最终值）从64增加到100。重复Python调用从1,834减少到1,044。在仅编辑响应技术正确的64对中，原始模型已在36对中计算出正确值但未提交技术正确的最终答案。编辑模型在64对中的13对纠正了计算。在相同50个问题上使用六个额外检查点，技术正确答案在900对中从96增加到154。我们用十个检查点各十个测试种子探索了三个选定问题。在熔解温度问题上，正确Python输出从60减少到22，而技术正确最终答案从0增加到18。权重编辑改变了Q

extra.description: Weight-space programming allows a language model to edit another model's weights without gradient-based training. We used Claude Opus 5.5 to edit Qwen3.5-0.8B and investigated how the edits changed its use of Python on computational biology problems. We compared four initial edited checkpoints with the original model on 50 test problems across three test seeds, yielding 600 paired evaluations. Strictly correct answers increased from 44 to 77, and technically correct answers, which included correct final values rejected for formatting, increased from 64 to 100. Repeated Python calls decreased from 1,834 to 1,044. Among the 64 pairs in which only the edited response was technically correct, the original model had already computed the correct value in 36 but did not submit a technically correct final answer. The edited model corrected the computation in 13 of the 64 pairs. With six additional checkpoints on the same 50 problems, technically correct answers rose from 96 to 154 across 900 pairs. We explored three selected problems with ten test seeds for each of ten checkpoints. On the melting-temperature problem, correct Python outputs decreased from 60 to 22 while technically correct final answers increased from 0 to 18. Weight editing changed both the calculations Qwen ran and whether it submitted a correct answer.

items.title: PDO Drug Screening Data for Evaluating and Training AI Drug Response Prediction Models
items.title_zh: 用于评估和训练AI药物反应预测模型的PDO药物筛选数据
items.summary_zh: 抗癌药物反应预测（DRP）对于精准肿瘤学和治疗开发至关重要。目前，大多数DRP模型是使用永生化癌细胞系的药物筛选数据开发的，这些数据在基因组和分子水平上可能与患者肿瘤存在显著差异，尽管患者肿瘤反应是最终的预测目标。为帮助弥合这一差距并使DRP模型更接近其预期的临床应用，我们使用患者来源类器官（PDO）进行了四项药物筛选研究，PDO比永生化细胞系更忠实地再现患者肿瘤。这些研究产生了用于改进和评估DRP模型的数据，包括PDO系的多组学图谱、药物特征数据和治疗反应测量。利用这些数据，我们在三种模型构建场景下重新训练和评估了多个公开可用的DRP模型：仅使用细胞系数据训练模型、使用细胞系和PDO联合数据训练模型、以及在细胞系数据上预训练模型后在PDO数据上微调。然后我们在这些分析场景中评估和比较了模型在PDO上的预测性能。此外，我们还评估了不同实验室使用不同检测技术和/或实验方案生成的药物筛选活力数

extra.description: Anti-cancer drug response prediction (DRP) is critically important for precision oncology and therapeutic development. Currently, most DRP models are developed using drug screening data from immortalized cancer cell lines, which can differ substantially from patient tumors at the genomic and molecular levels, even though patient tumor response is the ultimate prediction target. To help bridge this gap and bring DRP models closer to their intended clinical application, we conducted four drug screening studies using patient-derived organoids (PDOs), which more faithfully recapitulate patient tumors than immortalized cell lines. These studies generated data for improving and evaluating DRP models, including multi-omics profiles of PDO lines, drug feature data, and treatment response measurements. Using these data, we retrained and evaluated multiple publicly available DRP models under three model-building scenarios: training models using cell line data only, training models using combined cell line and PDO data, and pretraining models on cell line data followed by fine-tuning on PDO data. We then evaluated and compared model prediction performance on PDOs across these analysis scenarios. In addition, we also assessed the consistency of drug screening viability data generated by different laboratories using different assay technologies and/or experimental protocols.

items.title: Synaptic Dendritic Neuron Model (scDNM) for Cell Type Classification in Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Data
items.title_zh: 突触树突神经元模型（scDNM）用于单细胞RNA测序数据中的细胞类型分类
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中的细胞类型分类具有挑战性，因为存在高维度、稀疏性和转录相似的细胞类型。我们开发了scDNM，这是树突神经元模型的改编版，结合了可学习的突触阈值、监督基因池、分阶段训练和集成预测。从Paul15、PBMC3k和Nestorowa数据集构建了六个二分类任务。所有模型均使用无泄漏的嵌套交叉验证进行评估，特征选择、缩放和超参数调优独立于外部测试折进行。scDNM在六个任务中的三个中排名第一（包括一次并列），并取得了最佳平均准确率排名（2.00），其次是XGBoost（2.75）、随机森林（3.33）、逻辑回归（3.33）和SVM（3.58）。在六类PBMC3k实验中，scDNM达到了95.997%的准确率和0.944的宏F1，而SingleR为94.243%和0.914。Garnett仅返回Unknown标签，被视为零覆盖的技术结果。消融分析支持了树突和

extra.description: Cell type classification in single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data is challenging because of high dimensionality, sparsity, and transcriptionally similar cell types. We developed scDNM, an adaptation of the dendritic neuron model incorporating learnable synaptic thresholds, a supervised gene pool, staged training, and ensemble prediction. Six binary classification tasks were constructed from the Paul15, PBMC3k, and Nestorowa datasets. All models were evaluated using leakage-free nested cross-validation, with feature selection, scaling, and hyperparameter tuning performed independently of the outer test folds. scDNM ranked first in three of six tasks (including one tie) and achieved the best mean accuracy rank (2.00), followed by XGBoost (2.75), Random Forest (3.33), logistic regression (3.33), and SVM (3.58). In a six-class PBMC3k experiment, scDNM achieved 95.997% accuracy and 0.944 macro-F1, compared with 94.243% and 0.914 for SingleR. Garnett returned only Unknown labels and was treated as a zero-coverage technical outcome. Ablation analysis supported the contributions of dendrites and synaptic thresholds. However, XGBoost achieved higher mean binary-task accuracy (96.20% versus 95.32% for scDNM), and across-task rank differences were not statistically significant. These findings demonstrate that scDNM is competitive for scRNA-seq cell type classification, although broader independent validation is required.

items.title: Latent Lattice Language Models
items.title_zh: 潜在格语言模型
items.summary_zh: 语言模型通常通过更深或循环层和潜在推理步骤增加每token计算，而更丰富的残差连接改善跨层信息流。我们转而增加计算容量：模型维持的活跃计算状态数量。我们引入潜在格（Lattice of Latents），一组沿时间循环运行的逐层水平潜在流，与流经深度的垂直残差流并存。与hyper-connections、mHC以及注意力或值残差类似，Lattice增强残差流，但不是通过深度添加或重路由残差路径，而是提供跨token持续存在的伴随计算状态。与混合Transformer-SSM架构（其循环状态主要作为序列混合的内部记忆）不同，这些潜在状态直接调节垂直流的注意力、KV缓存写入、MLP计算和解码。在20B FineWeb-Edu token上训练的Transformer上，406M参数的Lattice模型将验证困惑度从参数匹配Transformer的15.41降至14.40。这些增益扩展到架构变体

extra.description: Language models typically increase per-token computation through deeper or looped layers and latent reasoning steps, while richer residual connections improve information flow across layers. We instead increase computational capacity: the number of active computational states a model maintains. We introduce the Lattice of Latents, a set of per-layer horizontal latent streams that run recurrently along time, alongside the vertical residual stream that flows through depth. Like hyper-connections, mHC, and attention or value residuals, the Lattice enhances the residual stream, but rather than adding or rerouting residual pathways through depth, it provides companion computational states that persist across tokens. Unlike hybrid Transformer-SSM architectures, whose recurrent states primarily serve as internal memory for sequence mixing, these latents directly condition the vertical stream's attention, KV-cache writes, MLP computation, and decoding. On Transformers trained on 20B FineWeb-Edu tokens, a 406M-parameter Lattice model lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 to 14.40 over a parameter-matched Transformer. These gains extend across architectural variants. The Lattice composes with prior residual-stream enhancements: with hyper-connections and input residuals, it lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 (base Transformer) and 14.22 (Transformer with the same enhancements) to 13.61. On Gated DeltaNet, Mamba-2, Triadic GDN, and GDN-Mamba-2 hybrids, it improves perplexity at every tested native state size, with Lattice-GDN and Lattice-Triadic-GDN variants outperforming pure baselines with 4x larger native states. These results identify persistent per-layer state as a complementary axis for scaling language-model computation.

items.title: ViRA: Toward Ultra-High-Resolution Visual Agents via Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization
items.title_zh: ViRA：通过跨输入相对策略优化迈向超高分辨率视觉智能体
items.summary_zh: 视觉智能体通过放大相关区域来回答关于超高分辨率照片的问题。然而，现有智能体往往凭常识而非阅读证据来回答。对最终答案进行强化学习（RL）无法纠正这一点，因为猜测与阅读获得相同奖励。我们提出跨输入相对策略优化（CrossRPO），在对比集上训练智能体。对比集就同一问题询问图像的多个版本，这些版本仅在小区域（含证据）不同且答案不同，因此只有阅读证据才能解决整个集合。CrossRPO奖励解决整个集合，我们证明它不会强化凭常识回答的集合。我们通过编辑21至120兆像素图像中的一个小物体来构建训练（ViRA-Train）和评估（ViRA-Bench）对比集，并拍摄具有真实变化的进一步集合（ViRA-Bench-Real）以排除编辑痕迹。我们仅用约3,500条ViRA-Train项目分别通过CrossRPO训练两个视觉推理智能体ViRA-9B和ViRA-27B。CrossRPO在最大分辨率下在ViRA-

extra.description: Visual agents answer questions about ultra-high-resolution photos by zooming into the relevant regions. However, existing agents often answer from common sense instead of reading the evidence. Reinforcement learning (RL) on the final answer cannot correct this, because a guess earns the same reward as reading. We propose Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization (CrossRPO), which trains agents on contrast sets. A contrast set asks one question about several versions of an image that differ only in a small region with the evidence and have different answers, so only reading the evidence solves the whole set. CrossRPO rewards solving the whole set, and we prove that it does not reinforce a set answered from common sense. We build contrast sets for training (ViRA-Train) and evaluation (ViRA-Bench) by editing one small object in images of 21 to 120 megapixels, and we photograph further sets with real changes (ViRA-Bench-Real) to exclude editing traces. We train two Visual Reasoning Agents, ViRA-9B and ViRA-27B, with CrossRPO on only about 3,500 items of ViRA-Train each. CrossRPO achieves 63.3% set accuracy on ViRA-Bench at the maximum resolution, against 59.3% for GRPO. ViRA-9B is the most accurate open model of its size on all benchmarks, and ViRA-27B outperforms Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6-Luna, both at their highest thinking level, on most benchmarks.

items.title: Quantifying the added value of human forecaster discussions for tropical cyclone intensity prediction
items.title_zh: 量化人类预报员讨论对热带气旋强度预测的附加价值
items.summary_zh: 国家飓风中心定期发布热带气旋讨论，为其热带气旋预报提供见解。本研究考察这些讨论在一组数值预测因子之外对强度预报的附加价值。对于2002-2023年飓风季的637个大西洋和东太平洋热带气旋，我们分析讨论文本及其与来自SHIPS和ERA5 10米风场的13个飓风环境预测因子的组合，使用三种建模方法预测24至120小时提前期的强度变化。在一种方法中，文本的端到端深度学习框架显示，仅讨论对24小时强度预报提供的价值与SHIPS预测因子相当。在五个此类模型的集成中将讨论信息添加到SHIPS预测因子，将2022-2023年气旋24小时最大持续风速预报的平均绝对误差从9.89降至8.90 kt，当对整个风暴重采样时置信区间排除零。ERA5风场对风速预测的平均绝对误差影响较小，模型排名因预测变量、提前期和模型类型而异。我们提供这些预报的预测区间，其在快速增强期间的覆盖率低于90%目标。文本分析显示，与强度

extra.description: The National Hurricane Center routinely releases Tropical Cyclone Discussions that offer insights into its tropical cyclone forecasts. This study examines the added value of these discussions for intensity forecasting beyond a set of numerical predictors. For 637 Atlantic and eastern North Pacific tropical cyclones from the 2002-2023 hurricane seasons, we analyze the discussion text and its combination with 13 hurricane environmental predictors from SHIPS and ERA5 10-meter wind fields, for forecasting intensity changes at lead times of 24 to 120 hours using three modeling methods. In one approach, an end-to-end deep learning framework for the text shows that the discussions alone offer comparable value for 24-hour intensity forecasts to the SHIPS predictors. Adding discussion information to the SHIPS predictors in an ensemble of five such models reduces the mean absolute error of 24-hour maximum sustained wind forecasts for 2022-2023 cyclones from 9.89 to 8.90 kt, with a confidence interval that excludes zero when whole storms are resampled. The ERA5 wind fields have a minor effect on mean absolute error in wind predictions, and model rankings differ across predicted variables, lead times and model types. We provide prediction intervals for these forecasts, whose coverage falls below the 90% target during rapid intensification. Analysis of the text shows that words related to intensity and intensity change (such as intensify, weaken, eyewall and category) are important for the model predictions. This retrospective study shows the added value of the forecasters' discussions and suggests that multi-modal learning can help understand the predictive contribution of expert human judgment. The reanalysis data differ from real-time analyses, and the discussions are issued at least three hours after the valid time of the other inputs, so these results should not be interpreted operationally.

items.title: SADL: On the Demand-Supply Geometry of Representation Collapse
items.title_zh: SADL：表征坍缩的需求-供给几何
items.summary_zh: 在联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）中，良好约束的投影器输出本身并不能防止表征坍缩。我们发现，从初始化开始，编码器表征就被不同输入共享的分量主导。批量归一化投影器移除该分量，因此投影器后的正则化无法纠正它，表征之间的差异缩小直至坍缩。我们提出SADL（供需损失），它保持原始训练目标并在需要时直接约束编码器。SADL比较投影器输出所需求的表征差异与编码器能够保留并传递给投影器的差异，仅在供给不足于需求时对编码器添加约束。它适用于不同的需求正则化器，不引入辅助网络、额外可训练参数或架构更改。在单任务和联合训练的四任务LeWorldModel（LeWM）和INTACT实验中，SADL将十个随机种子的坍缩率从50%降至0%。训练一个epoch后，编码器有效秩是无SADL对应基线的3.4-6.4倍，潜在预测误差降至其1/20-1/303。无需额外调优，SADL在其损失权重跨越数量级时保持稳健，且使用多个需

extra.description: In Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs), a well-constrained projector output does not by itself prevent representation collapse. We find that, from initialization, the encoder representation is dominated by a component shared by different inputs. A batch-normalized projector removes this component, so regularization after the projector cannot correct it, and the differences between representations shrink until they collapse. We propose SADL (Supply And Demand Loss), which keeps the original training objective and constrains the encoder directly when needed. SADL compares the representation differences that the projector output demands with the differences the encoder can retain and pass on to the projector, and adds a constraint on the encoder only when supply falls short of demand. It works with different Demand Regularizers and introduces no auxiliary networks, additional trainable parameters, or architectural changes. In single-task and jointly trained four-task LeWorldModel (LeWM) and INTACT experiments, SADL lowers the collapse rate over ten random seeds from 50% to 0%. After one epoch of training, encoder effective rank is 3.4-6.4 times that of the corresponding baseline without SADL, and latent prediction error falls to 1/20-1/303 of it. Without additional tuning, SADL stays robust as its loss weight spans orders of magnitude, and with several Demand Regularizers INTACT exceeds 95% mean search-free control success. On four image datasets, SADL also consistently improves accuracy and stability across random seeds. These results show that matching the representation differences a regularizer demands with the differences the encoder can supply leads to faster and more stable representation learning in control and image classification.

items.title: CertiSum: Bitwise-Identical MXFP4 Training Across Platforms and Parallelism Layouts
items.title_zh: CertiSum：跨平台和并行布局的逐位相同MXFP4训练
items.summary_zh: 使用MXFP4（一种4位微缩放格式）训练是非确定性的：相同输入在不同并行布局和GPU供应商之间可能产生不同结果。这些差异使调试和训练审计复杂化，并可能导致训练和推理引擎不一致。我们提出CertiSum，使MXFP4训练在运行、并行布局和GPU供应商之间逐位不变。其关键见解是MXFP4乘积的原生FP32累加对每个求和顺序通常已经精确。CertiSum在量化期间收集统计量以认证原生矩阵乘法结果，精确重算未认证输出，并在认证很少成功处直接使用精确内核。CertiSum保持量化块跨布局不变，并无舍入地合并部分和，包括在注意力和权重梯度计算中。在200步Qwen3-8B-Base实验中，CertiSum在AMD MI350X和NVIDIA GB200之间以及MI350X上数据、张量和上下文并行变化之间逐位保持训练状态。在MI350X上使用FineWeb-Edu的三个8B--14B模型中，在较大评估输

extra.description: Training with MXFP4, a 4-bit microscaling format, is non-deterministic: identical inputs can produce different results across parallelism layouts and GPU vendors. These differences complicate debugging and training audits and can cause training and inference engines to disagree. We present CertiSum to make MXFP4 training bitwise invariant across runs, parallelism layouts, and GPU vendors. Its key insight is that native FP32 accumulation of MXFP4 products is often already exact for every summation order. CertiSum collects statistics during quantization to certify native matrix multiplication results, recomputes uncertified outputs exactly, and uses exact kernels directly where certification rarely succeeds. CertiSum keeps quantization blocks unchanged across layouts and merges partial sums without rounding, including in attention and weight-gradient computation. In 200-step Qwen3-8B-Base experiments, CertiSum preserves training states bit for bit across AMD MI350X and NVIDIA GB200 and across changes in data, tensor, and context parallelism on MI350X. Across three 8B--14B models on FineWeb-Edu using MI350X, it adds 11.8--60.5% to training-step latency relative to its non-exact MXFP4 counterpart at the larger evaluated input shapes, with speedups of up to $1.24\times$ over BF16 and $1.70\times$ over deterministic BF16.

items.title: ScenarioForge: Resource-Grounded Generation and Execution Validation of Cyber Exercises
items.title_zh: ScenarioForge：资源接地的网络演习生成与执行验证
items.summary_zh: 网络靶场和夺旗场景构建仍然劳动密集，因为作者必须协调基础设施、易受攻击服务、攻击路径、工件和成功条件。LLM可以提出详细演习，但看似合理的描述并不保证可部署软件或可验证目标。我们提出ScenarioForge，将高层需求转化为资源接地的拓扑、服务、流量、分段和挑战链，然后在通用开放研究模拟器（CORE）中实例化和验证它们。ScenarioForge执行数据集包含226个物化场景，涵盖294个Vulhub镜像和所有85个使用我们AI辅助脚手架开发的定制挑战资源生成器。所有226个通过构建、预览、排序、部署、严格运行时验证和实时工件检查；其867个步骤（每个都是可单独验证的挑战目标）包括457个漏洞支持的和410个生成资源支持的实例。在单独的50提示匹配基准中，ScenarioForge+Qwen3.8和ScenarioForge+GPT5.6各实现50/50（100%）拓扑/构建成功和160

extra.description: Cyber-range and capture-the-flag scenario construction remains labor-intensive because authors must coordinate infrastructure, vulnerable services, attack paths, artifacts, and success conditions. LLMs can propose detailed exercises, but plausible descriptions do not guarantee deployable software or verifiable objectives. We present ScenarioForge, which turns high-level requirements into resource-grounded topologies, services, traffic, segmentation, and challenge chains, then instantiates and validates them in the Common Open Research Emulator (CORE). The ScenarioForge Execution Dataset contains 226 materialized scenarios covering 294 Vulhub images and all 85 custom-built challenge-resource generators developed with our AI-assisted scaffolding. All 226 passed construction, preview, sequencing, deployment, strict runtime validation, and live artifact checks; their 867 steps, each an individually verifiable challenge objective, comprise 457 vulnerability-backed and 410 generated-resource-backed instances. In a separate 50-prompt matched benchmark, ScenarioForge+Qwen3.8 and ScenarioForge+GPT5.6 each achieved 50/50 (100%) topology/build success and 160/160 intent fields; direct frontier generation reached 41/50 builds and 147/160 fields only with the full cumulative scaffold: structure, vocabulary, policy, and container-image guidance. The test still omitted ScenarioForge's downstream challenge-resource generation, dependency/flag sequencing, deployment, and live validation. The artifacts support operationally rich, reproducible exercises for training and evaluation.

items.title: When Do Histology Foundation Models Need Geometric Test-Time Augmentation?
items.title_zh: 组织学基础模型何时需要几何测试时增强？
items.summary_zh: 测试时增强（TTA）在推理期间聚合输入多个变换视图的模型预测。由于组织学图像缺乏规范方向，$D_4$ TTA——在正方形的8个旋转和反射上池化——是计算病理学中的标准默认。然而，具有固有旋转不变性的自监督组织学基础模型（FM）的兴起对其持续效用提出质疑。我们在四个patch级和两个全切片图像（WSI）数据集上基准测试9个组织学FM和6个通用模型。我们发现$D_4$ TTA仍然是可靠的事后改进，但收益从通用骨干的$+1.98$个百分点（pp）降至组织学FM在TCGA-UT上的$+0.50$ pp，并对最大模型进一步缩小。为消除计算开销，我们的实验表明熵路由——选择性地对不确定预测应用TTA——在仅增强${\sim}13\%$样本的同时恢复大部分增益。最后，我们表明patch级TTA改进不会转移到切片级多实例学习（MIL）。代码：https://github.com/lars-chen/his

extra.description: Test-time augmentation (TTA) aggregates model predictions across multiple transformed views of an input during inference. Because histology images lack a canonical orientation, $D_4$ TTA---pooling across the 8 rotations and reflections of a square---is a standard default in computational pathology. However, the rise of self-supervised histology foundation models (FMs) with inherent rotational invariance calls its continued utility into question. We benchmark 9 histology FMs and 6 general-purpose models across four patch-level and two whole-slide image (WSI) datasets. We find that $D_4$ TTA remains a reliable post hoc improvement, but benefits diminish from $+1.98$ percentage points (pp) for general-purpose backbones to $+0.50$ pp for histology FMs on TCGA-UT, and shrink further for the largest models. To eliminate computational overhead, our experiments demonstrate that entropy routing---applying TTA selectively to uncertain predictions---recovers most of the gain while augmenting only ${\sim}13\%$ of samples. Finally, we show that patch-level TTA improvements do not transfer to slide-level multiple instance learning (MIL). Code: https://github.com/lars-chen/histology-tta

items.title: Severe but Harmless: Stress-Testing Shift Severity for Frozen Time-Series Forecasters
items.title_zh: 严重但无害：对冻结时间序列预测器的偏移严重性压力测试
items.summary_zh: 零样本时间序列基础模型（TSFM）已成为任务特定模型的有吸引力替代品，因为它们无需逐序列训练即可处理包括异常检测和预测在内的多样下游任务。然而，时间序列数据经历分布偏移，两个状态之间的不相似性通常用Wasserstein-1等统计度量评分，较高分数被解读为更严重的偏移。在使用三种既定严重性度量对来自三个标准交通数据集的九个状态偏移进行系统实验中，我们表明这些度量不能可靠地预测实例归一化TSFM的退化。被评为最严重的状态并非使模型退化最多的状态，退化在最低评分状态中达到29%。在大多数情况下，审计显示测量严重性与模型退化之间没有正相关关系。我们提供基于等变性的压力测试分析，解释为何严重性读数可能与模型退化脱钩。

extra.description: Zero-shot time-series foundation models (TSFMs) have become attractive alternatives to task-specific models because they handle diverse downstream tasks, including anomaly detection and forecasting, without per-series training. However, time-series data undergo distribution shifts, and the dissimilarity between two regimes is commonly scored with statistical measures such as Wasserstein-1, where a higher score is read as a more severe shift. In systematic experiments using three established severity measures on nine regime shifts from three standard traffic datasets, we show that these measures do not reliably predict degradation for instance-normalized TSFMs. The regimes rated most severe are not the regimes that degrade the models most, and degradation reaches 29% in the lowest-scoring regime. In most cases, the audit shows no positive relationship between measured severity and model degradation. We provide an equivariance-based stress-testing analysis that explains why severity readings can become decoupled from model degradation.
